'''Petru Soltan''' (29 June 1931 – 15 July 2016) was a Moldovan [[mathematician]]. He was a member of the [[Academy of Sciences of Moldova]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://hosting.asm.md/index.php?go=detalii-membri&n=65&new_language=1|title=Details of ASM members|work=asm.md|accessdate=14 January 2017|archive-date=27 December 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131227090510/http://hosting.asm.md/index.php?go=detalii-membri&n=65&new_language=1|url-status=dead}}</ref> and an honorary [[list of members of the Romanian Academy|member of the Romanian Academy]].<ref name="dubasari.md">[http://www.dubasari.md/soltan.html Personalităţi marcante] {{webarchive|url=https://archive.today/20120724154734/http://www.dubasari.md/soltan.html |date=2012-07-24 }}</ref> Petru Soltan was a member of the Mathematical Society of Moldova.<ref>[http://www.math.ntnu.no/ems/council10/sofiatabledpapers/MoldovaPresentation.pdf Mathematical Society of the Republic of Moldova. An overview over the state of the mathematical activities in the Republic of Moldova] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110727191134/http://www.math.ntnu.no/ems/council10/sofiatabledpapers/MoldovaPresentation.pdf |date=2011-07-27 }}</ref>

Petru Soltan served as member of the [[Parliament of Moldova]] (1990–1994)<ref>[http://www.vipmagazin.md/tema/deputa%C5%A3ii_primului_Parlament/ Cine au fost şi ce fac deputaţii primului Parlament din R. Moldova (1990-1994)?] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151208141358/http://www.vipmagazin.md/tema/deputa%C5%A3ii_primului_Parlament/ |date=2015-12-08 }}</ref> and is a leader of the [[Democratic Forum of Romanians in Moldova]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://codru.eu/en/news/1-latest-news/523-declaratia-forului-democrat-al-romanilor-din-moldova-privind-necesitatea-scoaterii-partidului-comunistilor-in-afara-legii|title=DomRaider|work=codru.eu|accessdate=14 January 2017|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20110218044258/http://codru.eu/en/news/1-latest-news/523-declaratia-forului-democrat-al-romanilor-din-moldova-privind-necesitatea-scoaterii-partidului-comunistilor-in-afara-legii|archivedate=18 February 2011}}</ref>

He died on 15 July 2016 at the age of 86.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.presedinte.md/eng/presa/presedintele-timofti-a-semnat-un-necrolog-in-memoria-academicianului-petru-soltan|title=Obituary. Petru Soltan|work=presedinte.md|accessdate=14 January 2017}}</ref>

==Awards and honours==
* Doctor Honoris Causa [[Babeș-Bolyai University]], [[Cluj-Napoca]] (1992),
* Doctor Honoris Causa Academy of Economic Studies of Moldova (1998)
* Doctor Honoris Causa al Universităţii Pedagogice de Stat din Tiraspol, cu sediul la Chişinău (2000).
* Doctor Magna cum Laudae al ULIM (1994),
* Honorary Professor [[Petre Andrei University of Iași]] (2001).
* Membru titular [[Academy of Sciences of Moldova]] (din 1992),
* honorary member [[Romanian Academy]], 1993.
* Om emerit al Republicii Moldova (1994),
* Medals Acad. S. I. Vavilov (Moscova, 1991),
* Medal "Meritul Civic" (1996),
* Medal Mihai Eminescu (2000),
* Medal Dimitrie Cantemir (Academy of Sciences of Moldova, 2001).
* Moldova's National Prize in Science and Technology, 2004<ref name="dubasari.md"/>
